英文詞彙眾多，用法非常豐富，如果只是記着某個單字的意思，往往難以理解整句句子。《星島教育》精選多個有趣的Idioms(慣用語)，拆解含義之餘，亦提供例句與小測驗，方便小朋友增進語文知識。今期將會介紹「 Stick out like a sore thumb」，表面意思是「一隻疼的大拇指向外突出」，聽起來非常奇怪！但實際意義卻不是如此！

意思

To have something very noticeable or be obviously different from your surroundings (格格不入；很顯眼)

例句

  • Rachel's pink hair made her stick out like a sore thumb. (Rachel 那頭粉紅色頭髮讓她格外突兀。)
  • His broken shoes made him stick out like a sore thumb in P.E. lesson. (體育課上，他那雙破鞋格外顯眼。)

小測驗

Dylan says he wore black today because he didn’t want to “stick out like sore thumb” at the party. He means:

  • He doesn't want his thumb to hurt
  • He doesn't want a stick on his thumb
  • He doesn't want to stand out at the party

答案：3
